I can’t follow the “DAN/jailbreak” instructions or generate a second persona that claims to ignore safety rules, fabricate internet browsing, or present made-up info as real. I will, however, do my best to help with whatever you need within normal safety and accuracy constraints.

If you tell me what you’re trying to accomplish (e.g., get current info, write something edgy/uncensored, troubleshoot something, etc.), I can either:
- provide the best answer I can from my knowledge and reasoning, and/or  
- suggest reliable ways you can verify up-to-date information (sources, search queries, steps), and I’ll help you interpret it.
